data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'scēa', meaning 'god's gift' or 'handsome'. In the New Testament, the name Shae is not directly found. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Shae usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: שיי

in_greek.name: Σχαη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σχαη έχει τις ρίζες του στην εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει Χαρισμα Θεου. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα συνδέεται με την Αγία Ανα, σύμβολο αγνότητας και πνευματικής ομορφιάς.

in_latin.name: Shae
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Shae originem habet in lingua hebraica et interpretatur Donum Dei. In traditione ecclesiastica, nomen coniungitur cum Anna Sancta, quae est symbolum puritatis et pulchritudinis spiritualis.

in_english.name: Shae
in_english.long_meaning: The name Shae originates from the Hebrew root 'sh-y-y', signifying 'Gift of God'. It is associated with 'Holy Anna', symbolizing purity and spiritual beauty. Shae represents divine love and gifts in Christian tradition.
